messages:
Hannah Price: FYI customer "Orchid Labs" filed a billing discrepancy for April. They say daily totals on April 12 don't match their internal logs; they think ~200k tokens missing between 00:00-00:30 UTC. Can eng investigate ingestion timing?
Luis Moreno: Which pipeline? ingestion edge, or async replayer?
Hannah Price: They provided request_ids and timestamps. Looks like the calls hit the edge but our meter shows them in the April 13 window instead.
Carmen Reyes: I checked the edge proxy traces. We had a deployment at 2026-04-12 00:05 UTC that briefly caused the proxy to buffer writes to the ingestion topic for ~18 minutes while backpressure smoothed out. Some events were appended with later ts during ingestion commit. Sample: ```json
{"edge_ts":"2026-04-12T00:06:12Z","req_id":"orch-7a9","status":200,"tokens":340}
{"ingest_commit_ts":"2026-04-12T00:24:45Z","ledger_ts":"2026-04-13T00:01:12Z","req_id":"orch-7a9","tokens":340}```
Carmen Reyes: The ingestion writer sets ledger_ts to the commit time in the ingestion window (local cluster timezone) which in this case rolled into the next day's bucket because of a timezone normalization bug.
Tom Briggs: So tokens were recorded, but attached to 2026-04-13 instead of 2026-04-12. That's a window mismatch, not lost tokens.
Luis Moreno: Quick aggregate from billing mirror by ledger_ts: ```sql
SELECT ledger_date, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM metering_ledger
WHERE org='orchid' AND ledger_date IN ('2026-04-12','2026-04-13')
GROUP BY ledger_date;
-- 2026-04-12: 12,340,000
-- 2026-04-13: 12,780,000
```
Luis Moreno: If we reassign the 00:00-00:30 UTC events back to 04-12 we'd move ~200,000 tokens from 04-13 -> 04-12.
Hannah Price: Customer wants a corrected April 12 daily report and explanation. Their accounting month closes on 04-15 so they asked for a CSV and an estimate of credit if we can't reissue daily report.
Carmen Reyes: Two options: (A) perform a ledger re-datemap that moves events to original edge_ts date (safe, but requires controlled backfill), or (B) provide a customer-facing correction CSV and apply a one-time adjustment entry without changing ledger dates. Internal preference?
Tom Briggs: I think we should correct the ledger to preserve daily totals for customers. But we must tag the change with an audit marker and ensure invoice generation is reproducible.
Luis Moreno: Agreed. We'll run a dry-run re-datemap that writes to temp_ledger and produces per-event diffs + checksum. Quick dry-run estimate: moved_tokens=198,760.
Hannah Price: Finance: can we approve ledger correction? If invoices already generated for April 12 day-of, we may need to reissue or provide a balancing credit.
Tom Briggs: Also need to fix the timezone normalization bug in ingestion writer so ledger_date = date(edge_ts) for buffered commits. ENG ticket created ENG-5182.
billing-bot: Precheck: re-datemap backfill requires: (1) export snapshot (2) dry-run CSV + checksum (3) finance approval.
Hannah Price: I think we should proceed with dry-run and then decide. Please run dry-run and attach CSV.
Luis Moreno: Dry-run started. I'll include original ledger_ts, edge_ts, and proposed ledger_date in the CSV. ETA 90 minutes.
Carmen Reyes: Note: this impacts only events that were buffered during 00:00-00:30 UTC on 04-12 and whose ledger_date != date(edge_ts). We'll filter by the deployment-id and buffer window to limit scope.
Luis Moreno: Dry-run complete. Uploaded CSV to s3://fin-audit/dryruns/1805001234-redatemap.csv md5=7c5e1a9b2d3e4f6a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c. Rows=1,420. moved_tokens=198760.
Hannah Price: Finance: Recommend ledger correction and reissue day-level report. If invoices already billed for that day we will mark adjustment and reissue a corrected daily report; no monetary credit needed because tokens are still billed in the same monthly invoice window, just different day. Approve?
Tom Briggs: Engineering will include audit markers and create a reconciliation report so accounting can validate invoice parity.
Hannah Price: Approve ledger correction for Orchid Labs. Please include audit CSV and checksum in customer communication and note ENG-5182 fix. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Dry-run verified. Backfill commit gated: awaiting accounting sign-off for invoice parity verification.
Luis Moreno: I'll schedule controlled commit after accounting confirms invoice parity checks. Will update this thread with commit CSV and commit md5.
Carmen Reyes: Also patching ingestion writer to set ledger_date = date(edge_ts) for buffered commits. PR opened and under review.
Hannah Price: Thanks team. Once ledger corrected, send the corrected daily report and a short note: "We corrected the date assignment for a small set of events caused by buffering during a deployment; attached corrected CSV and audit checksums. No net change to monthly totals."
Tom Briggs: Will do. Closing loop after commit and customer confirmation.
